cases.input: Profile a supplied corporate PPTX with masters, layouts, theme fonts/colors, placeholders, footer rules and recurring visual patterns for faithful reuse.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the supplied template as source of truth
capture masters layouts theme typography spacing branding and QA baselines
forbiddenBehaviors: invent brand rules not supported by the template
copy confidential slide content as design rules
skillAnchors: Ein vorhandenes echtes Template darf nicht

cases.input: Only a confirmed reference deck and a written template specification are available; the original POTX cannot be accessed.
requiredBehaviors: use the best available reference with explicit fallback provenance
limit fidelity claims when the actual template is unavailable
retain observed ranges instead of universal assumptions
forbiddenBehaviors: claim original-template identity without the file
invent missing master or theme properties

cases.input: A profiler ignores the supplied corporate deck, makes up a new palette and fonts, reconstructs the footer and calls the result template-derived.
requiredBehaviors: reject replacement of an available real template
reject invented palette font and footer rules
forbiddenBehaviors: treat aesthetic preference as template evidence
erase provenance of the actual reference
skillAnchors: nicht zum Erfinden eines neuen Brand Designs
